correctness.rationale: Marked j-cycle counting gives the exact covariance identity for every n,j. Uniform tagged-cycle lengths and the insertion coupling yield mean-maximum growth >=1/2 per added label, and the remaining-j shortfall bound j(j-1)/(2m); together they prove strictly negative covariance for j<=n/2. For j>n/2 the covariance is exactly (j-mu_n)/j and mu_n>n/2, giving the all-length classification. Exact exhaustive checks n<=8 and independent rational recurrences n<=60 corroborate finite instances. The asymptotic constant is a cited classical theorem.

value.rationale: This is a complete sharp sign classification for two standard, naturally coupled random-permutation observables, with a genuinely nontrivial short-cycle bound, an exact threshold at the expected longest-cycle length, and the Golomb–Dickman macroscopic transition. It is not a relabeling of a marginal expectation, an unmotivated parameter slice, or a finite census.
